mechanism: input-gated ordered unit-state with tanh proposals, following minGRU step1
scope: unit sequence within one generated program; learned weights saved separately in each organism life

learning.targets: existing ordinary execution/novelty or game reward
learning.eligible_positions: original chosen failure-localized choices or explicit reward_choices; max12 equallyspaced distinct byte positions
learning.backpropagation: one full reverse pass through BOS and all generated units, including deterministic ones; actual EOS when present
learning.model_input: deterministic sparse signed hash of learned unit identity; no syntax or command text

controls.default: off; old snapshots and RNG unchanged
controls.readout_off: same trainedcheckpoint disable onlymemoryduring frozen evaluation

invariants: source-bound update inputs validate before mutation

quality_comparison.new_defaults: only after registered development and conditional confirmation gates
